description: Google Search API: Google Trends related queries. The searches people also make, for each keyword: `top` (most searched, 0 to 100) and `rising` (fastest growing, % increase over the previous period; `breakout` above +5000%). Lists are empty when Google has too little data. Price: 3 credits per call; failed calls are free.

category.description: Google Trends category id (0 = all categories)

from_date.description: Custom range start (YYYY-MM-DD, from 2004-01-01; with `to_date`, not with `time_range`)

geo.description: Country (`US`) or region (`US-CA`); worldwide when left out

keywords.description: Up to 5 keywords to compare, separated by commas

property.description: Which Google search: web, image, news, YouTube or Shopping

name: google_trends_related_queries
title: Google Trends related queries
